seo_title: What Is Alpha Now? SafZ and Average Joes Crypto on CR2
meta_description: SafZ on building the AlphaGEMs community over five years; Average Joes Crypto on Q4, why onchain experimentation slowed, and the bull case for Mosh.
summary: Chill Pill and R2D2 look back at CR2's first month and talk about security fears and how to keep money safe, before SafZ explains how he has kept the AlphaGEMs community together for five years and how he sees Robinhood Chain. Average Joes Crypto then gives his read on Q4, why he thinks onchain experimentation has slowed, and why he sees a long-term opportunity in assets the market is ignoring.
takeaways: SafZ says a long-lasting community needs a clear one-line mission, a founder who is present every day, careful choice of new members and removing people who damage the culture.
He sees value in members who rarely post but give solid calls, and describes the community as a family as much as a trading group.
SafZ likes that Vlad engages directly with the community and expects Robinhood Chain to stay, while noting some in the trenches felt the team was disconnected at first.
Average Joes Crypto argues onchain experimentation slowed because the traditional support for experimental projects fell away, even though building is now easier with abundant block space and AI.

His approach to alpha: there is little sophisticated long-term capital onchain, so assets with a clear case that the market ignores can be an opportunity, but each trader should focus on their own strategy, timeline and size.
